rows.ARS:
Pink blend Floribunda.
Exhibition name: Roseraie du Chatelet ®
rows.Bloom: Pink to carmine-pink. Mild fragrance. 40 to 55 petals. Average diameter 4". Large, very full (41+ petals), globular bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Bushy. Medium, semi-glossy, dark green, dense foliage.

Height: 31" to 39" (80 to 100cm). Width: up to 28" (up to 70cm).
